evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 459.
findings: 0-Ki Power Up Super associated with Recoome and PQ17. It temporarily increases Stamina recovery. Current evidence supports the PQ17 endpoint and core Power Up identity; exact multiplier, duration, frame data, reward probability, and hidden gates remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
Reward probabilities and hidden prerequisites are not promoted unless directly evidenced.
